description:
ETLBox CLI is the command-line engine for ETLBox DirectSync jobs.

Run scalable ETL and data synchronization tasks from JSON configuration files.
Supports SQL databases, files (CSV, Excel, JSON, XML, Parquet), and API endpoints with streaming execution and low memory usage.

Use ETLBox CLI for automation in scripts, CI/CD pipelines, scheduled jobs, and containerized workloads.

For tutorials, examples, and documentation, visit:
https://www.etlbox.net/
releaseNotes:
We are constantly improving ETLBox - adding new features, fixing bugs, and enhancing performance to make data integration even easier.

For the latest updates and detailed release notes, visit: https://www.etlbox.net/release-notes/
